ns2:course.label: Financial Accounting for Governmental and Nonprofit Entities
ns2:course.description: In this Governmental and Nonprofit Accounting course, students will experience an in-depth study of governmental and nonprofit accounting practices, focusing on financial reporting, budgeting, and fund accounting. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the unique accounting principles and regulations applicable to the public and nonprofit sectors. By the end of the course, students will know how to create and analyze financial transactions for governmental and nonprofit entities. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit is not given toward graduation for both ACCY 419 and ACCY 519. Prerequisite: ACCY 301 or ACCY 501 or consent of department.
